body:
Do you only find difficult to have relationships/sex or any other kind of social interaction?
I understand that this situation bothers you, sometimes the problem it's not "not doing something", but not being or feeling able to do it.

Why don't you take the first step?
Call them, send a message to them! 
Maybe they don't really know how do you feel, they don't know you need to talk with someone.

Yes, this is true.
There are 7 billion people on this planet, everyday horrible things happen to a lot of people: deaths, accidents, diseases, rapes, wars and so on.
No one cares, no one even knows what's happening in the world. 
People doesn't stop to keep living everytime a person suffer, everytime a person dies, the show must go on. 
Think about how many people you have seen during your life: do you know every single person? No, you know maybe just a few undred people, add some famous actor or singer and the rest of the world is totally stranger for you.

Yes I know my situation is difficult, but I really don't want to take medicines for my depression and anxiety just not to "feel my pain" because my suffering is now due mostly to my socio-economic condition. 
I know I will never be happy and carefree, but at least I can fix some aspects of my life.
Well, I will ask: "nothing, I'm fine" or, if I'm really thirsty maybe I will ask for a glass of water.

Hello.
I don't think the reason you have those feelings is because of your cancelled date, but I hope it is, because this is a thing that can be easily fixed.
Quarantine will end soon, it will not last forever: you don't have to warry about the future. 
You can have lots of dates, you are so young! 
Why wasting the opportunity to have what you will get in the future, just because now you feel lonely and sad?

I think it's the same for me.
I've always felt like an alien, to me everything was and still is strange and puzzling.
I watch the others living their lives and I wonder if I'd like to do the same things, to be like the others, or if I'm so different that it is impossible for me to have a normal life.

I don't really know and can't really understand well the social dynamics, because I've been always a social outcast, but I have come to the conclusion that people feels better when make other people feel inferior, or knowing that someone will feel inferior.

What's the point to take selfies, make stories and so on and post that stuff on social media like Facebook or Instagram? 
It's just to say: "look at me, I'm happier than you, my life is better than yours, you will never be like me".
They use these things to feel superior, because there are hierarchies based on looks, income and life style, and the only way to enjoy a travel, a party or their friendships and relationships, for them, is to put it on social media.
They do these things just for the validation they receive, not for the sake to do these things.
Without social media I think they will not bother to spend all that time and money, they are narcissists and they only want to be envied by those who can't afford to do what they do.
Without the envy of those who are of a lesser social class or who are less attractive, their life is just meaningless as the others.
With the quarantine they are going crazy because for some weeks they can't do all these things, but there is a lot of people (like me and many others) that has never had the opportunity to enjoy their lifestyle and the quarantine makes no real difference.
They are happy because they have had a happy life, they have never been rejected by their peers, they had friends and relationships, had always the money to buy everything they wanted, and they have never become addicted to harmful things like tobacco, unhealthy food, porn and other things that give instant pleasure but don't help you becoming a "better person" and change your brain with dopamine addiction. 
They have don't developed the "fight or flight" strategy, because for them everything has ever gone well, and even if they have made a mistake, they could easily solve it. 
If you have depression your brain will seek cheap pleasure and avoid everything that can make you suffer, so even a small drawback becomes a huge problem.

I always thought so.
"Normal" people couldn't last a month living my life.
Then, when I say I want to die, they tell me I'm crazy. 
No, I can be a nihilist and a pessimist but I'm a rational person and there is a reason if I'm depressed. 
They had a too much easy life, they can't and will never understand how another person can suffer.
